title: Stage 5: Persistence
summary: Versioned JSON save files, validation of untrusted data, and migrating an old format.

steps.title: Saving and loading safely
body: The board is saved to `localStorage` (or sent to an API) as JSON. Loading is where bugs hide, because the text may be:
- broken (a crash mid-write, a hand edit)
- from an **older version** of your app, with a different shape
- partly invalid (one corrupt task should not lose the whole board)
Professional save formats carry a **version** number and a migration path:

Version 1 of this app (already in users' browsers) stored `done: true | false` instead of `status`, and had no `tags`. Loading it should **migrate** each task: `done: true` becomes `status: "done"`, otherwise `"todo"`, with `tags: []`.
Everything from `JSON.parse` is `unknown` until each field is checked.

steps.title: serialize and deserialize
prompt: - `deserialize(text: string): Result<{ board: Board; skipped: number }>`:
- not valid JSON: `{ ok: false, errors: ["invalid json"] }`
- not an object, or `tasks` is not an array: `["bad format"]`
- `version` not 1 or 2 (including missing): `["unsupported version"]` (check this before `tasks`)
- version 1 tasks are migrated first (see the card)

- then each task is validated: non-empty string `id`, non-empty `title` (trimmed), a valid `status` and `priority`, `tags` an array of strings, numeric `createdAt`. Invalid tasks, and later tasks repeating an id, are **skipped**; `skipped` counts them
- only the known fields are kept
The round trip `deserialize(serialize(board))` must give back an equal board.

return updateTask(board, action.id, t => (t.title === title ? t : { ...t, title }));
return updateTask(board, action.id, t => (t.status === action.status ? t : { ...t, status: action.status }));
return updateTask(board, action.id, t => (t.priority === action.priority ? t : { ...t, priority: action.priority }));

function undoable<S, A extends { type: string }>(reducer: (state: S, action: A) => S, limit = 50) {

function updateTask(board: Board, id: string, change: (t: Task) => Task): Board {
function boardReducer(board: Board, action: Action): Board {
return updateTask(board, action.id, t => (t.title === title ? t : { ...t, title }));
return updateTask(board, action.id, t => (t.status === action.status ? t : { ...t, status: action.status }));
return updateTask(board, action.id, t => (t.priority === action.priority ? t : { ...t, priority: action.priority }));
type Filter = { status?: Status; priority?: Priority; tag?: string; search?: string };
const PRIORITY_RANK: Record<Priority, number> = { high: 0, medium: 1, low: 2 };
function selectTasks(board: Board, filter: Filter = {}): Task[] {
const counts: Record<Status, number> = { todo: 0, doing: 0, done: 0 };
function undoable<S, A extends { type: string }>(reducer: (state: S, action: A) => S, limit = 50) {
return { past: h.past.slice(0, -1), present: h.past[h.past.length - 1], future: [h.present, ...h.future] };
return { past: [...h.past, h.present], present: h.future[0], future: h.future.slice(1) };
const next = reducer(h.present, action as A);
return { past: [...h.past, h.present].slice(-limit), present: next, future: [] };
return JSON.stringify({ version: STORAGE_VERSION, tasks: board.tasks });
if (typeof raw !== "object" || raw === null) return null;
const r = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
return { id: r.id, title: r.title.trim(), status: r.status as Status, priority: r.priority as Priority, tags: r.tags as string[], createdAt: r.createdAt };
if (typeof raw !== "object" || raw === null) return raw;
const { done, ...rest } = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
function deserialize(text: string): Result<{ board: Board; skipped: number }> {
if (typeof data !== "object" || data === null) return { ok: false, errors: ["bad format"] };
const d = data as Record<string, unknown>;
if (d.version !== 1 && d.version !== 2) return { ok: false, errors: ["unsupported version"] };
if (!Array.isArray(d.tasks)) return { ok: false, errors: ["bad format"] };
return { ok: true, value: { board: { tasks }, skipped: rawTasks.length - tasks.length } };

const dojoMk = (id: string, title: string, extra: Partial<Task> = {}): Task => ({ id, title, status: "todo", priority: "medium", tags: [], createdAt: Number(id.slice(1)), ...extra });
const dojoStep = undoable(boardReducer);
Dojo.eq("history still works", 1, dojoStep(initHistory<Board>({ tasks: [] }), { type: "add", task: dojoMk("t1", "A") }).past.length);
const dojoB: Board = { tasks: [dojoMk("t1", "Write", { tags: ["docs"] }), dojoMk("t2", "Ship", { status: "done", priority: "high" })] };
const dojoText = serialize(dojoB);
Dojo.eq("serialize writes version 2", 2, JSON.parse(dojoText).version);
Dojo.eq("round trip", { ok: true, value: { board: dojoB, skipped: 0 } }, deserialize(dojoText));
Dojo.eq("invalid json", { ok: false, errors: ["invalid json"] }, deserialize("{oops"));
Dojo.eq("unsupported version", { ok: false, errors: ["unsupported version"] }, deserialize('{"version":9,"tasks":[]}'));
Dojo.eq("no version", { ok: false, errors: ["unsupported version"] }, deserialize('{"tasks":[]}'));
Dojo.eq("tasks not an array", { ok: false, errors: ["bad format"] }, deserialize('{"version":2,"tasks":{}}'));
Dojo.eq("not an object", { ok: false, errors: ["bad format"] }, deserialize("42"));
const dojoMixed = JSON.stringify({ version: 2, tasks: [
{ id: "a", title: "Good", status: "todo", priority: "low", tags: [], createdAt: 1 },
{ id: "b", title: "Bad status", status: "later", priority: "low", tags: [], createdAt: 2 },

null,

Dojo.eq("invalid tasks are skipped", ["a"], dojoR.value?.board.tasks.map((t: Task) => t.id));
Dojo.eq("skipped count", 4, dojoR.value?.skipped);
const dojoV1 = JSON.stringify({ version: 1, tasks: [
{ id: "old1", title: "Legacy", done: true, priority: "medium", createdAt: 7 },

Dojo.eq("version 1 is migrated", { ok: true, value: { board: { tasks: [
